Easy Commands~

Easy to use commands for your group!

/start
Bot ko jagane ke liye~ checks status.
/couple
Group ka aaj ka couple check karo! Finds matching members.
/search
Kuch bhi pucho, I'll search and tell you. Groq AI powered.
/antispam
Spam settings adjust karne ke liye (Admins only).

Admin panel for moderation settings.
